rules.description: All normalized scores must be between 0 and 100.
Relative humidity and percentages must be between 0 and 100.
Minimum temperature must not exceed maximum temperature.
Positive-duration and shelf-life fields must be greater than zero when present.
LITERATURE, STANDARD, and REGULATORY records must reference at least one source.
ASSUMPTION and SYNTHETIC records must include a non-empty notes field.
SYNTHETIC training rows must include generator_version.
Numerical OTR/WVTR values require unit, measurement condition, source, and confidence.
Food and packaging IDs must be unique and referenced IDs must exist.
Comparative carbon-footprint scores must not be exported as absolute kg CO2e values.
Unknown or unreviewed source records should be visible as warnings in the UI.
A compatibility record below the eligibility threshold must include hard_constraint_reason.
Food category and physical-state values must use the controlled vocabulary.
Any material recycling or composting claim must include region/condition notes when applicable.
